title: Singular Rotational Self-Similar Tori for Odd $σ_k$-Curvature Flows
summary: For every pair of integers $3\leq k<n$ with $k$ odd, we construct a compact embedded rotational torus in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ whose homothetic dilations satisfy the unnormalised $σ_k$-curvature flow in a Sobolev almost-everywhere sense. Its profile curve has Hölder regularity $C^{1,1/k}$ and Sobolev regularity $W^{2,p}$ for every $1\leq p<k/(k-1)$. Away from two singular latitudes the torus is smooth; globally, the flow equation is interpreted using the weak shape operator of the associated Lipschitz boundary.
